boundary: Financial / Assets would be a direct second harm only if the export contained usable payment credentials (full card numbers or CVV) instead of card suffixes and merchant-side processor references.
factor: whether disclosed payment data is masked or usable
note: The assessor described card suffixes and processor references as 'exposure of payment credentials', but the export says full card numbers are not displayed. The misread inflated a speculative financial consequence into an independent harm; the confidentiality breach alone matches gold.
